critical_code_review_comments: Estimates.js still uses module-level `lineSeq` counter for line-item _key (noted in iteration_7); consider crypto.randomUUID() for SSR/HMR robustness. Non-blocking.

Individual estimate line-item inputs (desc/qty/unit_price) still lack data-testid attributes (only container-level testids exist). Suggested: data-testid={`line-item-desc-${i}`}, `line-item-qty-${i}`, `line-item-price-${i}` and a `line-item-remove-${i}` for the remove button. Improves future automated coverage.
